hook: Partial reprogramming trades rejuvenation for recovery differently in each human cell type.
summary: Researchers briefly reprogrammed human fibroblasts, T cells and aortic endothelial cells and tracked recovery. Endothelial cells recovered identity and improved vascular function, T cells recovered only from shallow reprogramming, and fibroblasts recovered incompletely. TOX was a shared dependency but its downstream programs differed by lineage. The work uses cultured cells, so benefits in living tissue are untested.
title: Partial reprogramming reveals lineage-specific uncoupling of rejuvenation, function, and recoverability in human cells
